_meta_nav_six_clusters_note: nav-six-clusters (2026-08-20, design.md §4 rows 19-22): the DBACompliance top-level group duplicated the Compliance-cluster's existing DBA cards (DBAIntakeWizard/DBAPortfolioDashboard/DBAEvidenceBrowser/DBAModelovereenkomstRegister in src/manifest.json). Confirmed near-identical: DBAOpdrachten/DBAOpdrachtDetail, DBAPortfolioRisicos/DBAPortfolioRisicoDetail, DBAEvidenceDossiers/DBAEvidenceDossierDetail, DBAModelovereenkomsten/DBAModelovereenkomstDetail (both index AND detail pairs — the detail pages' field sets are near-supersets of each other, so both sides of each pair are deleted together rather than risking new nav-reachability orphans) — all 4 pairs deleted, the canonical Compliance-cluster page in each pair survives. `DBAIntakes` (schema DBAIntake — NOT a duplicate of DBAIntakeWizard/DBAOpdracht despite the similar label; design.md did not catch this, it has its own distinct schema) and `DBARisicoflags` (schema DBARisicoflag, genuinely unique, per design.md) are the two DBACompliance children design.md's own row count (4 of 6) undercounted — both survive and fold into ReportingCompliance via menu-layout.json#relocations (DBACompliance -> ReportingCompliance).

config._note: DBA intake is a scored assessment REPORT (gezag / persoonlijke arbeid / financieel risico / Deliveroo criteria) that produces the total risk score and interpretation for one assignment. Body leads with the score fields; KPI surfaces the total score and max, and the parent assignment is linked so the assessor can jump back to the engagement. No comms — a compliance record; audit trail in a sidebar tab.
config._relatedCollectionsNote: KEY: the prop is `relatedCollections`; a `relatedLists` block is not a prop on any Cn page component, lands in $attrs and renders nothing while every gate stays green. TOKEN: `@object.assignmentId`, NOT `@objectId` — this is a SIBLING relation, not a parent/child one: both DBAIntake and DBARisicoflag carry a flat `assignmentId` FK onto the same third object (DBAOpdracht, example 'dba-opdr-2026-0042'). `@objectId` would resolve to the intake's own UUID and match zero flags.

config._note: Risk flag is a single detected DBA-risk signal against an assignment — its type, severity, detection moment, legal basis (fiscaleBron), suggested action and resolution memo. A compact alert record: the body shows the flag detail and resolution, with a link back to the parent assignment. No comms; the audit trail sidebar tab records who acknowledged/resolved the flag.
